temporal_basis: Mean of June and late-August standing biomass in not-yet-mown plots
measurement_basis: Published site-productivity range for dry standing biomass; not collected yield or delivered feed
applicability: Ten Dutch roadside grasslands across a productivity gradient; closest regional evidence found for roadside-grass biomass.
limitations: Do not convert to annual or collected tonnes without accessible area, cutting fraction, regrowth and collection-loss data.
